final: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) as hero_count FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha2 JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength')
